title: Repair spike-induced silent period for roofline metrics and span handoff gaps affecting customer dashboards
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: During a sustained cross-tenant ingest surge on 2026-03-07 we observed a 7-12 minute silent window where roofline (per-tenant token/latency) metrics dropped to zero and tracing spans failed to stitch for affected tenants. This resulted in blank live panels for a subset of Hosted and Dedicated customers and escalations from two enterprise customers. Scope: Hosted API, Dedicated GPU pools, and Private deployments using the console viewer. Goal: implement a robust fix that prevents short-term ingest bursts from causing metric eviction + span handoff failures and add mitigations to surface missing signals faster in the console.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate a burst: publish 10x normal request rate against a single tenant for 8 minutes using load-tool (rps-surge-sim)
2) Verify roofline metrics collector CPU saturates and ingestion buffer fills (observed in metrics-ingest-group)
3) Observe console live-panel for that tenant shows no data and span stitching shows gaps between 2026-03-07T15:12:00Z and 2026-03-07T15:20:00Z
4) Check backend: metric shards experience eviction due to index-ttl compaction and span-handoff queue dropped events
reproduction_notes: We reproduced locally in staging using the nightly telemetry bundle. The failure only manifests when ingest backpressure coincides with shard compaction window (TTL-based compaction). Lowering compaction aggressiveness prevents the window but increases index size — trade-off noted.
impact: Two enterprise customers reported missing SLA telemetry during the surge, causing alerts to fire and one customer to open an escalation with Support. Affected dashboards showed blank tiles for 7-12 minutes and tracer UI had orphaned spans that could not be stitched to parent traces.
root_cause: Race between the ingest-side writeback pipeline and the TTL compaction job: when writeback backlog grows and the compactor runs, index segments are pruned aggressively, which temporarily removes recently-written metric index pointers. Concurrently, span-handoff queuing hit a soft limit and the handoff worker dropped ~3% of events. The combination caused the console query layer to return empty time series and tracing gaps.
mitigation_and_fix: 1) Immediate mitigation (hotfix): increase handoff queue capacity and add transient backoff for the compaction job when backlog > threshold. Deployed to Hosted and Dedicated control plane as emergency patch (hotfix-ENG-508137). 2) Permanent fix: implement a writeback-safety marker that pins recent index segments for 10 minutes post-ingest to avoid compaction eviction, and add conditional compaction backoff logic tied to writeback backlog metrics. 3) Observability addition: add alerting for metric-silence-detection (tile-empty > 2 minutes) and tracing gaps heuristic (orphaned-span-rate > 0.5%).
deployment_plan: Step 1: Deploy hotfix to Hosted control plane (canary 10% tenants) — 2026-03-09 02:00 UTC
Step 2: Monitor metric silence alerts and orphaned-span rate for 2 hours; rollback if error rates increase
Step 3: Deploy permanent change to compactor + index pinner in a staged rollout: staging -> dedicated canary -> remaining dedicated -> hosted -> options for private customers via patch bundle
Step 4: Publish private deployment patch bundle and upgrade notes for on-prem customers (include KMS/HSM guidelines)
qa_and_validation: Load test under surge profile for 30 minutes and verify no >1m silent windows across 5 tenants
Run fuzzed trace-emission test to validate span handoff reliability under backlog
Confirm console live-panel tiles return continuous points and trace stitching recovers parent-child links
Post-deploy: compare pre/post token-level latency and per-tenant metric completeness (delta < 0.2%)
notes: Design trade-off: padding index retention by 10 minutes increases disk requirements ~3-6% depending on tenant churn; this was accepted for safety for the next two quarters
Support playbook updated: confluence link and canned customer messaging for missing dashboard tiles
Follow-up: add tenant-level ingest pressure dashboard and a customer-facing status note when live-panel data is incomplete
